sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your response; please note that as a matter of company policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our pricing strictly reflects the verified increases in raw material and production indices, but we are prepared to revise our offer to €5.93 per unit under the current terms. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We can present our Angebot at a price of €5.93 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Should you be in a position to increase the order volume or commit to a longer contract duration, we would be able to review the pricing further. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
